title: mentha arvensis var. villosa
intro: Mentha arvensis var. villosa, commonly known as woolly wild mint, is a variety of the Mentha arvensis plant species. It is a perennial herb native to Europe and Asia, known for its hairy leaves and minty flavor. Woolly wild mint has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including aiding digestion, relieving nausea, and reducing inflammation, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include menthone, limonene, and beta-pinene, which have been shown to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
